    <script>
      const slide1 = document.getElementById('slide-1');
      const slide2 = document.getElementById('slide-2');
      const startButton = document.getElementById('startButton');
      const startButtonWrapper = document.getElementById('startButtonWrapper');
      const instructionText = document.getElementById('instructionText');
      const popupHi = document.getElementById('popupHi');
      const stage = document.getElementById('stage');
      const boy = document.getElementById('boy-container');
      const girl = document.getElementById('girl-container');
      const defaultInstructionText = 'Drag the sad guy to you Grace';
      const successInstructionText = "Will he be happy....?";

      let heartInterval = null;
      let startButtonTimer = null;
      let storyInterval = null;

      function showStartButton() {
        startButtonWrapper.classList.add('visible');
        startButtonWrapper.style.opacity = '1';
        startButtonWrapper.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
      }

      function hideStartButton() {
        startButtonWrapper.classList.remove('visible');
        startButtonWrapper.style.opacity = '0';
        startButtonWrapper.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      }

      function createHeart() {
        const heart = document.createElement('div');
        heart.classList.add('heart');
        heart.textContent = '💓';
        const x = Math.random() * (stage.clientWidth - 50);
        heart.style.left = x + 'px';
        heart.style.animationDuration = (Math.random() * 2 + 3) + 's';
        stage.appendChild(heart);
        heart.addEventListener('animationend', () => heart.remove(), { once: true });
      }

      function startHeartRain() {
        if (heartInterval) return;
        createHeart();
        heartInterval = setInterval(() => createHeart(), 220);
      }

      function stopHeartRain() {
        clearInterval(heartInterval);
        heartInterval = null;
      }

      function lerp(a, b, t) {
        return a + (b - a) * t;
      }

      function rgbToString([r, g, b]) {
        return `rgb(${Math.round(r)}, ${Math.round(g)}, ${Math.round(b)})`;
      }

      function updateBoyMood() {
        const girlCenterX = 66;
        const girlCenterY = 0;
        const distX = Math.abs(boyX - girlCenterX);
        const distY = Math.abs(boyY - girlCenterY);
        const distance = Math.hypot(distX, distY);
        const progress = 1 - clamp(distance / 28, 0, 1);
        const romanticIntensity = clamp(progress * 1.5, 0, 1);

        const sadA = [201, 206, 216];
        const sadB = [122, 129, 141];
        const happyA = [191, 224, 255];
        const happyB = [93, 142, 199];
        const romanticA = [255, 194, 214];
        const romanticB = [219, 90, 150];

        const gradientA = [
          lerp(sadA[0], happyA[0], progress),
          lerp(sadA[1], happyA[1], progress),
          lerp(sadA[2], happyA[2], progress)
        ];

        const gradientB = [
          lerp(sadB[0], happyB[0], progress),
          lerp(sadB[1], happyB[1], progress),
          lerp(sadB[2], happyB[2], progress)
        ];

        const finalA = [
          lerp(gradientA[0], romanticA[0], romanticIntensity),
          lerp(gradientA[1], romanticA[1], romanticIntensity),
          lerp(gradientA[2], romanticA[2], romanticIntensity)
        ];

        const finalB = [
          lerp(gradientB[0], romanticB[0], romanticIntensity),
          lerp(gradientB[1], romanticB[1], romanticIntensity),
          lerp(gradientB[2], romanticB[2], romanticIntensity)
        ];

        boy.style.setProperty('--boy-gradient-a', rgbToString(finalA));
        boy.style.setProperty('--boy-gradient-b', rgbToString(finalB));

        if (distance < 8 && Math.abs(boyY) < 14) {
          boy.classList.add('happy');
          stage.classList.add('romantic-theme');
          stage.classList.remove('sad-theme');
        } else {
          boy.classList.remove('happy');
          if (romanticIntensity > 0.2) {
            stage.classList.add('romantic-theme');
            stage.classList.remove('sad-theme');
          } else {
            stage.classList.add('sad-theme');
            stage.classList.remove('romantic-theme');
          }
        }
      }

      let boyX = 22;
      let boyY = 0;
      let dragging = false;
      let startPointer = null;
      let stageSize = null;
      const boyBounds = { minX: 8, maxX: 80 };

      function triggerSuccess() {
        if (boy.classList.contains('happy')) return;
        boy.classList.add('happy');
        stage.classList.add('romantic-theme');
        stage.classList.remove('sad-theme');
        popupHi.classList.add('show');
        popupHi.style.opacity = '1';
        popupHi.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, 0) scale(1)';
        instructionText.textContent = successInstructionText;
        startHeartRain();
        hideStartButton();

        playPageAudio();

        if (startButtonTimer) clearTimeout(startButtonTimer);
        startButtonTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          showStartButton();
        }, 3000);
      }

      function resetSuccessState() {
        boy.classList.remove('happy');
        stage.classList.add('sad-theme');
        stage.classList.remove('romantic-theme');
        popupHi.classList.remove('show');
        popupHi.style.opacity = '0';
        popupHi.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, 18px) scale(0.85)';
        instructionText.textContent = defaultInstructionText;
        hideStartButton();
        stopHeartRain();
      }

      function clamp(value, min, max) {
        return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
      }

      function applyInitialBoyState() {
        boyX = 22;
        boyY = 0;
        boy.style.left = '22%';
        boy.style.bottom = '84px';
        boy.classList.remove('happy');
        stage.classList.add('sad-theme');
        stage.classList.remove('romantic-theme');
        popupHi.classList.remove('show');
        popupHi.style.opacity = '0';
        popupHi.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, 18px) scale(0.85)';
        instructionText.textContent = defaultInstructionText;
        hideStartButton();
        stopHeartRain();
      }

      function updateBoyPosition() {
        boy.style.left = boyX + '%';
      }

      applyInitialBoyState();
      updateBoyPosition();
      updateBoyMood();

      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
        if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return;
        if (boy.classList.contains('happy')) {
          startHeartRain();
        }
        if (!slide2.classList.contains('hidden')) {
          stepStory();
        }
      });

      boy.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        dragging = true;
        const bounds = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
        stageSize = { width: bounds.width, height: bounds.height };
        startPointer = {
          x: event.clientX,
          y: event.clientY,
          left: boyX
        };
        boy.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
        playPageAudio();
      });

      boy.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
        if (!dragging || !startPointer || !stageSize) return;
        const dx = (event.clientX - startPointer.x) / stageSize.width * 100;
        const dy = (event.clientY - startPointer.y) / stageSize.height * 100;

        boyX = clamp(startPointer.left + dx * 0.9, boyBounds.minX, boyBounds.maxX);
        boyY = clamp((dy * 0.4), -8, 18);
        boy.style.left = boyX + '%';
        boy.style.bottom = (84 + boyY) + 'px';
        updateBoyMood();

        const girlCenterX = 66;
        const girlCenterY = 0;
        const distX = Math.abs(boyX - girlCenterX);
        const distY = Math.abs(boyY - girlCenterY);

        if (distX < 8 && distY < 14) {
          triggerSuccess();
          dragging = false;
          startPointer = null;
          stageSize = null;
        }
      });

      function endBoyDrag() {
        dragging = false;
        startPointer = null;
        stageSize = null;
      }

      boy.addEventListener('pointerup', endBoyDrag);
      boy.addEventListener('pointercancel', endBoyDrag);
      window.addEventListener('pointerup', endBoyDrag);
      window.addEventListener('pointercancel', endBoyDrag);


      const storyBoy = document.getElementById('storyBoy');
      const storyPoints = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.story-point'));
      const storyTargets = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.story-target'));
      const pageAudio = document.getElementById('pageAudio');
      const waypoints = [
        { x: 120, y: 330 },
        { x: 300, y: 180 },
        { x: 520, y: 220 },
        { x: 700, y: 188 },
        { x: 900, y: 236 }
      ];

      let waypointIndex = 0;
      let direction = 1;
      let draggingStory = false;

      function setStoryBoy(x, y) {
        storyBoy.style.left = x + 'px';
        storyBoy.style.top = y + 'px';
      }

      function refreshStoryMarkers() {
        storyPoints.forEach((point, index) => {
          point.classList.toggle('visible', index === waypointIndex);
        });
        storyTargets.forEach((marker, index) => {
          marker.classList.toggle('active', index === waypointIndex);
        });
      }

      function getNearestWaypointIndex(x, y) {
        let bestIndex = 0;
        let bestDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;

        waypoints.forEach((waypoint, index) => {
          const distance = Math.hypot(x - waypoint.x, y - waypoint.y);
          if (distance < bestDistance) {
            bestDistance = distance;
            bestIndex = index;
          }
        });

        return bestIndex;
      }

      function stepStory() {
        const point = waypoints[waypointIndex];
        setStoryBoy(point.x, point.y);
        refreshStoryMarkers();

        if (waypointIndex >= waypoints.length - 1) direction = -1;
        else if (waypointIndex <= 0) direction = 1;
        waypointIndex += direction;
      }

      function startStoryAnimation() {
        if (storyInterval) return;
        storyInterval = setInterval(stepStory, 1500);
      }

      function playPageAudio() {
        if (!pageAudio) return;

        try {
          pageAudio.muted = false;
          pageAudio.volume = 1;

          const playPromise = pageAudio.play();
          if (playPromise && typeof playPromise.then === 'function') {
            playPromise.catch(() => {
              setTimeout(() => {
                try {
                  pageAudio.muted = false;
                  pageAudio.play().catch(() => {});
                } catch (error) {}
              }, 80);
            });
          }
        } catch (error) {}
      }

      setStoryBoy(waypoints[0].x, waypoints[0].y);
      refreshStoryMarkers();

      storyBoy.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
        draggingStory = true;
        storyBoy.classList.add('dragging');
        storyBoy.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      });

      storyBoy.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
        if (!draggingStory) return;

        const bounds = storyBoy.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = clamp(event.clientX - bounds.left, 30, bounds.width - 30);
        const y = clamp(event.clientY - bounds.top, 30, bounds.height - 30);
        const nearestIndex = getNearestWaypointIndex(x, y);
        const target = waypoints[nearestIndex];

        if (Math.hypot(x - target.x, y - target.y) < 90) {
          setStoryBoy(target.x, target.y);
          waypointIndex = nearestIndex;
          refreshStoryMarkers();
        } else {
          setStoryBoy(x, y);
        }
      });

      storyBoy.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
        draggingStory = false;
        storyBoy.classList.remove('dragging');
      });

      storyBoy.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
        draggingStory = false;
        storyBoy.classList.remove('dragging');
      });

      startButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
        slide1.classList.add('hidden');
        slide2.classList.remove('hidden');
        startStoryAnimation();
        playPageAudio();
      });

      if (pageAudio) {
        pageAudio.muted = false;
        pageAudio.volume = 1;
      }
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
